title: [EOPATCH2] Problem when pairing patches [3.2.0.3-bb1a276078][MASTER]
symptom: When switching from virtual pump to EOPATCH2, it was not possible to link to EOPATCH2 patches. Several patches were lost and the only option was to link an Omnipod patch. After a couple of EOPATCH2 patches, it linked correctly, then failed again. When the problem occurs, it is not possible to link any EOPATCH2 patch; they all fail. When insulin is loaded and the beep sounds, the pairing message appears twice, and pressing them leaves you stuck without advancing to step 3.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The maintainer states 'The patch didn't pair with android. It's phone or patch related.' The user speculates about a previous patch not unlinking properly or a variable not taking a proper value, but no cause is confirmed.
fix: The thread does not provide a fix. The maintainer suggests trying another phone, but no resolution is confirmed.
evidence_quote: The patch didn't pair with android. It's phone or patch related. There is nothing we can do here
